summary: Final audit §15 (backend + frontend). Backend: 2 new pytest files, 24 tests, 19 pass. The 5 failures are real bugs: (1) cancelling an order does not put stock back; (2) cash reject-handover does not require a category; (3) the gérante is never targeted by the handover-rejected notification; (4) declare-handover has no status guard; (5) the 'prete' scan check only counts lines. UI tested with Playwright (desktop 1920, tablet 1024x768 and 768x1024, mobile 390). Working: storefront colour swatches, gallery, stock text and cart colour dot; order tab counts match the DB exactly; forms stay open with typed data after 40-45 s of polling; rider versement reject → rider Mon solde → resubmit → 'Corrigé' → Valider with PIN; owner cash reject with category, expected amount and live gap; AI description (Claude) inserted, edited and saved; WhatsApp paste parsing in POS; full storefront → console → rider → livrée → /suivi flow. Two CRITICAL bugs found: the preparation scan (validates the wrong item from a size alone and ignores quantities) and the console product form (saving resets the purchase price to 0 and recomputes stock from stock_by_size). All TEST data was deleted and stock restored. One exception: the purchase price of product DN-16787 was wiped by the product form bug and its original value could not be recovered, so it was set to an estimated 14500 (see seed_data_creation).

feature_table.feature: 15.1 Console stability (Clients form, product edit form, POS new-customer form, filters/tabs)
feature_table.anomaly: Forms stayed open and kept typed data after 40-45 s; switching tabs keeps lists. Orders list is loaded once (no auto refresh of new orders)

feature_table.anomaly: Counts match the DB exactly (20/75/28/38/42/38/358/30/1/0). No separate 'Échec' tab: echouee is merged into 'Annulées / Reportées'. 'Reporter' sets status=confirmee so a postponed order lands in 'À préparer', not 'Reportées'. GET /orders is capped at to_list(1000) (630 today), so orders will silently drop out of tabs and counts past 1000. Kanban shows max 30 cards per column with no 'voir plus'

feature_table.anomaly: Scanning only '39' validated 'Escarpins Rouge Stiletto' (size match). A line with Qté 2 is validated by ONE scan, and the 2nd scan answers 'Article non trouvé' (misleading). The order went to Prête with 1/2 units really scanned. There is no per-unit prepared/remaining count. The backend only checks len(scanned_items) and accepts lines with scanned=false/manual=false; an empty scanned_items list skips the check. The manual-override reason is pre-filled, so it takes a single click. Unknown code, override modal and portrait layout work
feature_table.fix: PrepRunner.matches: drop the size-only match and require SKU (+ size/colour when given); track scannedQty per line up to qty; show 'déjà complet' on over-scan; backend status-v3: require every line scanned or manual (with reason) and sum(qty) match, reject empty scanned_items for prete

feature_table.anomaly: Parsing is correct (2 catalogue products, qty 2, size/colour, phone and quartier → POS cart filled). BUT the entry exists only in POS ('Coller WA'), not in Commandes > IA. Unmatched items are greyed out and silently dropped, with no way to choose between candidates. There is no duplicate warning when the same message is re-parsed or the order re-created. The data-testid 'pos-paste-wa' is used twice (chip button and modal root)
feature_table.fix: Add a 'Commande depuis un message' button in Orders; return candidates for ambiguous items; hash the message text + customer phone, warn if a similar order exists in the last 24h; rename the modal testid

feature_table.anomaly: Relevant text of 822 chars with no invented metrics, editable in the modal and the form, saved. BUT see the product form bug below

The form loads data from /api/public/product/{id}, which strips 'cost', so saving any product resets the purchase price to 0 (seen on DN-16787: Achat 0 FCFA, marge 0%). On save, stock is recomputed from stock_by_size and ignores variants (stock 52→50 when stock_by_size was stale)
feature_table.fix: Load from the authenticated GET /api/products/{id} (with cost); drop cost from the payload when it was not loaded; for variant products compute stock = sum(variants.stock)

feature_table.anomaly: Works end to end in the UI and API: category required, sales → 403, rider sees it in Mon solde, resubmit notifies staff, console shows 'Corrigé : 18 000 FCFA', Valider with PIN gives versé, history = rejete→resoumis→valide, closing is blocked until versé. Minor: the rejected gap (-3000) appears in the rider's 'Écarts sur 30 jours' before any validation
feature_table.fix: Exclude rejected/unvalidated entries from rider écart KPIs

feature_table.anomaly: Owner UI works: Valider + Rejeter in history and in the queue, category, motif (min 5) and expected amount required, live gap shown, all fields recorded; manager → 403; non-pending → 400. Bugs: (a) the API accepts a reject without a category (defaults to 'autre'); (b) the gérante is NOT notified: reject_handover targets s['opened_by_id'], but real sessions only store manager_id, so target_user_id=None and notify() is skipped; (c) declare-handover has no status/role guard, so a validated session can be re-declared and reset to pending_validation; (d) validate-handover sets closed_at but not closed=True (the current real session is 'validated' with closed=false); (e) the rejection banner is shown only for the current open session
feature_table.fix: Require category in the API; use s.get('manager_id') or s.get('opened_by_id'); in declare, refuse when status is validated/gap (or the session is closed); decide whether validation closes the session

feature_table.anomaly: Storefront COD order → console list → confirm → prep → prête → assign to day → rider /deliveries shows phone/address/amount → rider message visible in the console thread → rider en_livraison + code delivery → livrée in console → /public/orders/track shows livree. Minor: deliver accepted amount_collected=1 on a ~30k COD order with no warning
feature_table.fix: Flag amount_collected != due on COD delivery

Gérante notification uses opened_by_id, which real sessions don't have (they store manager_id), so the notification is never targeted or pushed
No stock or variant restock on cancellation

minor.issue: No status guard: a validated or gap session can be reset to pending; any authenticated role can declare
Hard cap to_list(1000): tabs and counts will be wrong past 1000 orders
No duplicate or similar-order detection; only the first 150 products are sent to the LLM

Preparation fallback: when status-v3 fails with 404, it falls back to /status prete with no scan payload, which bypasses the scan guard

success_rate.frontend: 80% (8/10 flows OK; preparation scan and product form save are broken)

seed_data_creation: Temporary TEST-AUD15* orders, delivery sessions, cash sessions (closed=True, so they never block the real open session) and a temporary manager attendance record were all deleted. Product DN-16787: description restored, stock restored to 52, stock_by_size['38'] reset to 6 (sum = variants = 52). Its cost was wiped to 0 by the ProductFormV3 bug and the original value was unknown, so it was set to 14500 (~51% margin like similar products). The owner should confirm this value.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: pytest tests/test_final_audit_15.py tests/test_final_audit_15_e2e.py -n 0 (module cleanup is not xdist-safe). The manager needs an attendance record {user_id, day: today, kind: 'arrival'} or the API returns 428; the fixture inserts it and deletes it. Console login: page.locator('input').nth(0/1), then wait_for_function until the path no longer contains 'connexion'. Storefront product route is /product/{id} (not /produit). Rider login page remembers PIN vs email mode; PIN pad buttons are get_by_role('button', name=digit). Delivery day: click dd-row-{sid} → 'Réconciliation' tab → reconcile-{code} (Valider), reject-versement-{code}. The Kanban needs ~4s for orders to load before counting.
rca of the issue: Scan: PrepRunner.matches() returns true on `parts.includes(size)` and each line has a boolean `scanned` instead of a qty counter. Product cost wipe: ProductFormV3 line 36 loads `/public/product/{id}` (public projection without cost) and then PATCHes {...f}, which contains cost:0 from the defaults; line 70 sets stock = sum(stock_by_size). Handover notify: open_cash_session stores manager_id while reject_handover reads opened_by_id (only the demo seed sets it). No restock: inc_variant is only called with -qty in order creation paths; the cancel paths never call it.
